Various types of networks are investigated; the types include a multilayer perceptron (MLP) with a varying number of hidden layers, and an autoencoder. Experiments are done using a publicly available EEG signal database that contains two classes: normal and abnormal. The experimental results demonstrate that the proposed system achieves greater than 89% accuracy using the convolutional network followed by the MLP with two hidden layers. The proposed system is also evaluated in a cloud-based framework, and its performance is found to be comparable with the performance obtained using only a local server.
